notes.title: RELOW FREE-TO-PLAY
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845255/3d12f8d3cd0592f5908059a70cff85fa169badbb.png[/img]
[h2]WHY FREE-TO-PLAY[/h2]
Relow was released on 6 February 2020.
Since then, the [b]daily-players-count was always low[/b].
We never give up.
Almost every month, we published new content Updates.
Unfortunately, after almost a year since the release, we didn't reach the desired amount of players.
We moved to [b]free-to-play in order to reach more players[/b].
We don't want Relow as a death game.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IJG249B.png[/img]

[h2]RELOW SHOP[/h2]
Relow has [b]more than 300 unlockable items[/b].
To support free-to-play costs we are [b]introducing the SHOP[/b].
All purchasable items don't affect gameplay.
Shop items are:
[list]
[*] Packs (4.99$): Head + Body + Leg + weapon skin(for all weapons) + charm.
[*] Skins (1.99$): 1 weapon skin (for all weapons).
[*] Charms (1.99$): 1 weapon charm (for all weapons).
[*] Relow Cards (10x 4.99$ / 25x 9.99$ / 60x 19.99$).
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BLGeRoHh.gif[/img]

[h2]EARLY ACCESS BACKERS[/h2]
For Our Current Players:
If you purchased the game to date,
we heartily thank you with the following [b]rewards (valued at ~$30)[/b]:
[list]
[*] Limited edition SURVIVOR Pack
[*] 25x Relow Cards
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0rYB3gK.png[/img]

[h2]WHEN?[/h2]
Early access backers rewards are redeemable from now until the free-to-play launch.
The free-To-Play launch date isn't planned yet.

Warmly,
Relow Digital
